title: GaloisGuilds
tagline: Empowering Web3 communities: A 100% decentralized social platform where users can create public groups, fostering easy access to Web3 and unified communication.
description:
GaloisGuilds is a project made to reduce the gap of research, resources and communication that Web3 newcomers have when facing stablished web3 communities and concepts like DAOs, NFT collections, etc.  

GaloisGuilds is a Social Website for people and communities:  People can create Guilds, Data based groups allocated on the Blockchain for simple communication based on Post mechanism known in other Social media platforms. Powered by Tableland, GaloisGuilds design is completely simplified to a SQL database onchain logic, meaning that any type of abstraction made onchain can be shown in a Guild post.  Sky is the Limit!

Guilds and Posts for Hackathon Purposes are deployed on ETH Sepolia testnet! To test the app you must be connected to ETHSepolia chain.
Here is an RPC endpoint to the mentioned chain:
https://chainlist.org/chain/11155111

Here I have the main Pitch Presentation with recorded Demo & goals I would love judges to see calmly! https://www.canva.com/design/DAFx-PmonEc/giJbXW47Wv4bKT3wqu7W8Q/view?utm_content=DAFx-PmonEc&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link&utm_source=editor
how_its_made:
The core technology involved in GaloisGuilds is Tableland & Tableland Studio. Almost 100% of the repository is frontend made in React.js framework that connects to Tableland SQL database held on Sepolia Testnet. Users access the frontend fetching and inserting data into tables in Sepolia enhancing a serverless Social connection over the Blockchain. Tables are populated by human interaction, and can recieve all kinds of data (in the future all data will be displayed in a stylished way)

TL:DR Tableland & Tableland Studio are the core technologies involved. People interact via Posts made into Guilds created by the same people. People can create unlimited posts and guilds at expense of gas in Sepolia Testnet. Further development found in presentation will offer a full interaction with Blockchain capabilities and contracts in the same simple and concise manner GaloisGuilds beta was designed.
